slug: 2024-01-01 Liberia Mobile Money Regulations (Central Bank of Liberia)

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Liberia's Mobile Money Regulations are described as the regulatory framework governing electronic money and mobile-money operators in Liberia, with more than 11 million mobile wallets operating; the document gives no date for the regulations, so its 2024 published date (a year-level proxy) is used.

note: Reach not stated: the page does not say non-banks are licensed or that providers must connect.
